about: A *.test.ts(x) in a __tests__/ directory (never under its support/ or fixtures/) whose relative production imports, static, re-exported or dynamic, all resolve into one directory is a site at its path: it belongs beside that module (2.1-E3, ADR 0028:22); a test reaching two directories, none, or only test support is a cross-module suite and no site

files.src/__tests__/support/h.ts:
import { a } from '../../mod/a'
export const h = a
files.src/__tests__/one-module.test.ts:
import { describe, it } from 'vitest'
import { a } from '../mod/a'
import type { B } from '../mod/b'
import { h } from './support/h'
files.src/__tests__/cross.test.tsx:
import { a } from '../mod/a'
import { c } from '../other/c'
files.src/__tests__/directory-index.test.ts:
import { d } from '../other'
import { c } from '../other/c'

import { h } from './support/h'
